Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1076
Claimant:
Joseph Johnson
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
11-23-23
Claimant reported a low-speed head-on collision and a neck strain. The claimant is not represented by an attorney
and has been asked to provide any medical records directly.
11-25-23
Police report and two independent witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the collision. The
other driver's account matches the claimant's description of how the accident happened, and scene photos are
consistent with it.
12-10-23
The neck strain is a plausible injury for a crash of this type. Initial treatment was conservative, consistent with the
reported symptoms.
12-21-23
Claimant's medical history shows a small strain in the same area years ago, which healed fully with no ongoing
complaints at the time. Records from that episode are being requested for comparison.
12-26-23
Treatment has grown to many times the usual amount for this injury, with near-daily visits. New body areas were
added to the claim several weeks after the crash, and it is not yet clear whether all of the reported damage came from
this impact.
5-2-24
Claimant has since added small details to the account, but the core description of the collision has stayed the same
across each statement. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known, and nothing in the file suggests damage predates
the policy start date.
5-19-24
The driver is named on the policy. Pending receipt of the requested meidcal records and an independent medical
review, the file will remain open for evaluation of the treatment scope and its relationship to the collision.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
